newsitem.title: USA: Summit Holding stake held by group.
newsitem.headline: Summit Holding stake held by group.

text.p: A group including Greenlight Capital LLP, a New York-based investment firm, said Monday it holds a 10.3 percent stake or 499,000 common shares in Summit Holding Southeast Inc.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the shares in Summit, a Lakeland, Fla. company, between May 22 and May 30 at $11.00 to $14.50 each.
The group said it holds shares in the company for investment but reserves the right to contact the company or its shareholder regarding potential strategies to increase shareholder value.
